newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$500 mln real return bonds.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$500 mln real return bonds.

text.p: The Government of Canada said on Thursday it planned to auction on March 5 C$500 million of real return bonds with a coupon of 4.25 percent and maturing on December 1, 2026.
The bonds will be dated and delivered on March 12, the government said.
The bonds will be issued with accrued inflation compensation from December 7, 1995 and accrued coupon interest from December 1, 1996.
The reference consumer price index is 133.88065 and the index ratio on March 12, 1997 will be 1.0226.
The bonds are in addition to C$1.85 billion of the issue now outstanding. Proceeds will be used for general purposes.
